Appraiser remarks
The front bumper cover is cracked across the center, with the grille tabs broken and the upper radiator support bent slightly
rearward. The hood latch and both headlamp brackets show stress marks that match a low-speed frontal contact. Most of the
damage lines up with the impact as described. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and grille, straightening the
radiator support, and refinishing the hood. The labor hours on the estimate run a little high for this scope, so the shop should be
asked to justify them line by line. The invoices submitted show no repeated charges. No prior damage to the vehicle is known
from the file or the owner's records.
